post.description:
SSE state/heartbeat/result/error. Result is a complete InsightOutput, never partial model JSON.

POST once; no automatic reconnect, replay or regeneration after disconnect.
Generation is advisory and uses the same minimized context and quota policy as JSON APIs.

Admit one bounded monthly provider read. Request keys are actor/period-bound and replay without another provider call. AWS queries may incur charges. Up to three pending and twenty daily collections per organization; failed/ambiguous reads require an explicit new request key.

get.description: Return one immutable account-filtered observation report. Amounts include signed adjustments and separate currency totals. This is not an invoice and does not post into manual costs.
Security-authorized local configuration status; never probes AWS or reveals role credentials.
Finance-authorized local setup status; configured is explicitly unverified.
Explicit development-only sample; never a fallback or a stored/live billing report.

limitation.title: Limitation
limitation.default: Exact recorded metadata only; not semantic vulnerability deduplication or verified remediation

notice.title: Notice
notice.default: Illustrative sample amounts; no cloud account, provider request or recorded spending.

report.title: Report
report.description: Operational scan snapshot. stage and progress (0-100) describe phase completion, not elapsed time; completed_steps records finished phases. Progress reaches 100 only with durable completed status. Error text is sanitized; no credentials or source content are returned.

scope.title: Scope
scope.default: MESH account sessions; provider refresh sessions are not revoked by this operation
